units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 2:5">B. Bath. II, 5</cite> <he>מרחיקין … מן המ׳ וכ׳</he> you must build your wall at a distance of four cubits from your neighbor’s spout, so that he can put up a ladder (to repair it).
<cite ref="Bava Batra 22b:9">Ib. 22ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ משופעת</he> an inclined spout (under which people can pass).
<cite ref="Bava Batra 59a:3">Ib. 59ᵃ</cite> <he>מ׳ של בנין</he> a spout made of masonry.
<cite ref="Tosefta Tahorot 9:15">Tosef. Toh. IX, 15</cite> <he>המ׳ שהיתה שותה וכ׳</he> a spout which an unclean person broke apart while it was receiving and discharging liquids; a. fr.
